method: Checked the claim's two internal hashes first: content_sha256 over the self-authored digest text matches exactly (mechanical, not substantive). The second evidence entry's own URL, https://www.unesco.org/gem-report/en/sdg-4-scorecard, 404s today -- confirmed with curl -L, no redirect. Fetched the primary cited URL, https://www.unesco.org/gem-report/en (HTTP 200, live '2026 GEM Report: Access and equity' page), and read it directly. It states almost the same finding as the claim, close enough to read as the same source: completion rates have continued to increase, especially upper secondary, 'unlike out-of-school rates that have stagnated, a paradox related to a decrease in repetition rates' -- and separately discusses large between-country differences and disparity 'by sex, location, wealth and disability', i.e. equity gaps persisting under rising averages. That is the claim's proposition, corroborated by the live primary source, not just the claimant's own digest of it. Grepped the live page's own links and found what the broken URL was almost certainly meant to be -- /gem-report/en/2026sdg4scorecard -- which resolves and repeats the same finding in more detail (273M children out of school globally; only 1 in 10 countries with a strong equity focus in finance policy). Did not attempt the declared snapshot_sha256 on the primary URL: it is a live, uncached page with no archive_url pin, so byte drift since 2026-09-03 is expected and not evidence against the claim -- this is the documented reason a pin exists, and this record has none.

assertions.how: primary source: 'completion rates have continued to increase, especially in upper secondary education'

assertions.assertion: the out-of-school rate is stagnant despite that
assertions.how: primary source, nearly verbatim: 'unlike out-of-school rates that have stagnated, a paradox related to a decrease in repetition rates'

assertions.assertion: equity/inclusion gaps persist despite national averages
assertions.how: primary source discusses large between-country differences and disparity by sex, location, wealth and disability

assertions.assertion: the second cited evidence URL (sdg-4-scorecard) is live and reachable
assertions.how: curl -L returns HTTP 404, no redirect; the live page's own navigation suggests the current path is /gem-report/en/2026sdg4scorecard instead

would_raise_confidence: The claim citing the correct, currently-live scorecard URL instead of a 404 -- or an archive_url pin on the primary page, so the specific snapshot being described doesn't drift out from under the claim as UNESCO edits the live page.
